headline: okiek reaches ARC-2 gold as artificialagencylab.com slips out

sections.text: okiek gained 10.83 to reach 63.47, moving from 26th to 16th and into the public board’s gold places.
The move pushes artificialagencylab.com from 15th to 17th; its score is unchanged at 63.06, 0.41 short of the cutoff. The gold line is now 63.47.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
